units.intent: Async, non-blocking log shipper to a Fluentd TCP endpoint: callers push JSON records onto a lock-free ring buffer, a single background thread drains it and forwards to Fluentd, falling back to syslog() on failure.

objects.name: FluentdLogRecord
objects.role: one queued record: syslog priority + JSON payload string

objects.name: SFluentdLogger
objects.role: log() public API; openSocket/sendAll/senderLoop implementation; inline static instance/tag act as a process-wide singleton handle

naming_quality.note: instance/tag are bare public statics implementing a global singleton, a different pattern from this class's own private instance members (host/port/buffer/senderThread)

units.intent: Asynchronous, poll()-able DNS resolution: SResolve() starts a lookup on a detached thread (or resolves a literal IP inline) and hands back a shared SResolution both sides can safely outlive each other on.

objects.name: SResolution
objects.role: PENDING/RESOLVED/FAILED state machine with a self-pipe fd for poll()-based completion notification

objects.name: SResolve
objects.role: starts the lookup and returns the shared SResolution

naming_quality.note: consistent `_`-prefixed private members, bare public members/methods

units.intent: Lock-free, fixed-capacity, multi-producer/single-consumer ring buffer of T, used to hand log records from arbitrary caller threads to SFluentdLogger's sender thread without blocking.

objects.name: SRingBuffer::BufferElement
objects.role: one slot: a T plus its atomic<State>

misfits.why: declared at global scope instead of nested inside SRingBuffer, injecting a generic five-letter name into every translation unit that includes this header

name_fit.note: fits; a generic buffer, not Fluentd-specific, though it has one caller today

location_fit.note: fits, but its only consumer (SFluentdLogger) is the sole reason it lives in libstuff rather than a more general concurrency-utility location

naming_quality.note: consistent aside from the unnested, overly-generic State noted above

units.intent: Variadic function template that launches a thread like std::thread but captures any exception the callable throws and delivers it back to the caller through a std::future.

objects.name: SThread
objects.role: wraps f(args...) in try/catch on a new thread, routes return value or caught exception through a promise/future, returns {thread, future}

name_fit.note: PascalCase, S-prefixed free function reads as a type/constructor call rather than a function, given repo convention reserves that style for classes

naming_quality.note: S-prefix on a lower-case-callable function template is inconsistent with the repo's S-prefix-for-types convention
